thread.title: When Apple Sneezes, Suppliers Catch a Cold

author: HEDGE
title: When Apple Sneezes, Suppliers Catch a Cold
text:
READ MORE
Being a part of Apple’s (AAPL) supply chain can be a huge benefit to suppliers, but can also pose a liability. Several large Apple supplier stocks fell after Apple lowered its outlook for fiscal 2019’s first quarter. While Apple originally expected ~$93 billion in revenue in the December quarter, it now expects only ~$84 billion because of soft iPhone demand. Apple stock fell 10% on the first full trading day after its outlook cut, as did several Apple suppliers. Related Posts
